capabilities: Summarize URLs, PDFs, videos, audio and documents into notes
Chat with the vault using semantic RAG and research the web with citations
Generate and refine slide decks with PowerPoint and HTML export
Transcribe and format meeting recordings into structured minutes
Auto-tag notes with a hierarchical taxonomy and visualize the tag network
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not just a note/tag organizer; it is a broad AI assistant toolkit spanning chat, research, presentations, transcription and tagging.
extras: Positioned as an all-in-one suite; provider API usage costs are shown and confirmed before some calls, and embedding search has a zero-setup local option that needs no API key.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI features, so summarizing external content, vault-grounded Q&A, document generation and auto-tagging each require separate tools or manual work.

relations.evidence: Connect your Gmail via a simple Apps Script. The plugin fetches unread newsletters
Sends the sweep tasks you approved to your own Google Tasks
Kindle Sync — import highlights from My Clippings.txt or Amazon cloud

requires.name: Local LLM runtime (Ollama, LM Studio, LocalAI, Jan, KoboldCpp)
Google account for newsletter digest and Google Tasks export

summary: All-in-one AI toolkit that summarizes sources, researches the web, builds PowerPoint decks, transcribes meetings, and auto-tags notes.
